title: ICUE Assistant
greeting: Hello! I’m the ICUE assistant. I can help you find your way around our services, how we work, fees and how to reach us. What do you need?
error: Sorry — I could not answer just now. Please try again.

sync.title: Sync history
sync.description: Keep this conversation across your devices. Messages are encrypted before upload. No account is needed.
sync.hint: Paste the code from your other device.
sync.secret: Anyone with this code can read and change your synced history. Keep it private.
sync.confirmRemove: Delete the cloud copy and disconnect every device? Local messages will remain.
sync.sessionOnly: This browser cannot save the connection. Keep your code to reconnect.
sync.scope: Up to 50 recent messages per language are kept. Local conversations are merged when you pair devices.

status.offline: Offline — changes stay on this device until you reconnect.
status.missing: This code has no cloud history. It may have been deleted. Disconnect to create a new code.
status.unavailable: Sync is currently unavailable. Your local chat still works.
status.invalid: Check the pairing code and try again.
status.error: Could not sync. Your local messages are safe; try again.
